limitations: The target split is a previously inspected development replay, not an unseen holdout.
The 0.883212 score uses deterministic official-source adjudication for source-certified image rows, whereas V6 retained opaque VLM-judge verdicts for unchanged answers.
The direct solver-answer gain over V6 is one row; three additional gains are evaluator corrections backed by exact official sources.
No claim of 0.883212 holdout generalization is made.
